payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP where d[i] = min_{j<i} (b[j] * a[i] + d[j]), optimized with convex hull trick using a deque for amortized O(1) queries.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over trees, maintaining lines (slope=b[j], intercept=d[j]) in a convex hull for monotonically decreasing slopes and increasing query points a[i]. This is classic DP with CHT optimization, fitting dp_1d_state.
